mentions.name: GitHub Audience Atlas
mentions.description: This open-source web tool visualizes the distribution of any GitHub user's followers, following, and ghosts (users who don't follow back) on a world map. It is still under development, with responsiveness improvements pending.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built a web tool that visualizes the distribution of any GitHub user's followers, following, and ghosts (those who don't follow back) on a world map.
mentions.author: ThierryRkt
